annotations.title: Get a user's progress in a course

description: A user's progress in one course — status, progress rate, average score, time on course, completed units, and a per-section / per-activity breakdown. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}/courses/{cid}/progress.

course_id.description: The course id — the course slug, e.g. "my-first-course".

user.description: The user's id, or their email address.

name: learnworlds_get_user_course_progress
title: Get a user's progress in a course
